bibliographic.title: Parallel
bibliographic.author: Ethan Crosthwaite
bibliographic.description:
You wake up in a basement-like room that seems to defy the laws of physics. After you escape the room you find that the rest of the building is normal. Or so it seems. Part-way through the game, you will discover a pair of glasses that, when worn, change how you see things. Objects will become visible, writing on others will make sense. Sometimes they will impair your vision, forcing you to take them off.

This IF is a beginner story and should be quite easy to play through while still offering problematic puzzles. Extra information can be found in the story's zblorb file description.
